title: AI Account Research Assistant
tagline: Research target accounts and identify business problems worth solving.
businessOutcomes: Less time researching accounts before you reach out.
summary: Reviews websites, public listings, reviews, news, job posts, and CRM records to create a structured account research brief.
businessProblem: Enterprise and mid-market deals require deep account research, but reps default to skimming the homepage. Critical signals — hiring sprees, negative review patterns, leadership changes — get missed.
outcome: A structured account dossier with company overview, org map hints, pain hypotheses, competitive landscape notes, and recommended entry points for outreach or discovery.
expectedOutcomes: A structured account dossier with company overview, org map hints, pain hypotheses, competitive landscape notes, and recommended entry points for outreach or discovery.
whoItsFor: B2B sellers targeting named accounts — agencies pursuing specific brands, SaaS reps doing ABM, consultants building strategic account lists.
aiInputs: Target account name, domain, and known contacts
Website pages: about, services, careers, blog, leadership
Public reviews and listing data from Google/Yelp/TripAdvisor
CRM history if existing relationship or past opportunity
Job postings and news mentions if available via scrape or manual paste
aiOutputs: Account overview: what they do, size proxies, locations, key offerings
Pain hypothesis list with evidence links (reviews, careers, website gaps)
Likely decision-makers and influencer map from LinkedIn/public data
Recommended talk tracks and discovery angles
noCodeTools: ChatGPT deep research with website URLs pasted in
Clay.com account research table with website + reviews + GPT columns
Perplexity or Gemini for news and company research summaries
lowCodeTools: n8n: account list → Apify website scrape → OpenAI dossier → Notion page
Google Sheets account list + Outscraper + Claude batch briefs
Make.com: CRM account trigger → enrichment → research doc in Drive
customBuildStack: Apify website crawler for multi-page account scrape
Outscraper for reviews and listing cross-check
Apollo for contact and firmographic enrichment
Notion or CRM account note auto-population
implementationSteps: Define account research template sections and quality bar
Build website scrape pipeline — homepage, about, services, careers minimum
Add review and listing enrichment for local/multi-location accounts
Generate dossier per account; store in CRM account notes or Notion
Rep validates pain hypotheses before using in outreach
Refresh dossiers quarterly or on trigger (new funding, leadership change)
systemBehavior: Runs on-demand per account or batch weekly for ABM target list
Cites source URLs for every claim in the dossier
Read-only on public sources and CRM — writes research to notes only
Flags low-confidence sections when scrape fails or data is thin
Does not contact the account or trigger any outreach automatically
risks: Scraped website content may miss login-gated or JavaScript-heavy pages
AI-inferred pain points without evidence lead to off-target messaging
Job posting interpretation can misread growth vs. turnover signals
Research volume must respect robots.txt and platform terms of service
